Definition: a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim
BiblicalUsage: The Horonite is Sanballat, the enemy of Nehemiah's wall, and his title is all the name the record gives him. He is displeased when Nehemiah comes to seek the welfare of Israel, he mocks the builders on the wall, and his daughter marries into the priesthood that Nehemiah must cleanse.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sanballat's title is the mark of an outsider who opposes God's work, and his mockery is the oldest weapon against builders. I hold that the wall went up in spite of him, because God builds through the hands of His people.
